frame: glTF metres, +Y up, front = +Z, driver side (US left) = +X, origin on the ground (tyre contact) under the middle of the wheelbase

Wheel_FL.forward_roll_sign: positive rotation about local +X rolls the car forward (+Z)

Wheel_FR.forward_roll_sign: positive rotation about local +X rolls the car forward (+Z)

Wheel_RL.forward_roll_sign: positive rotation about local +X rolls the car forward (+Z)

Wheel_RR.forward_roll_sign: positive rotation about local +X rolls the car forward (+Z)

Door_FL.note: negative = rear edge swings out to +X

Door_FR.note: positive = rear edge swings out to -X

RearDoor.note: single side-hinged door, hinge on the passenger (-X) side as on the 1959 Miller-Meteor; positive = free edge swings rearward (-Z)

PackTray.note: telescoping beam, slides straight out of the rear door opening (local -Z = car rear)

PackTray2.note: swing rack on a turntable at the end of the beam; packs ride stored facing +X, after +90 deg about +Y they stand in one row behind the car, contact faces toward -Z

pack_sequence_s.stow: reverse order; rack_swing back to 0 first, then slide, then door

SteeringWheel.axis_note: local +Z points along the column toward the driver; local +Y = 12 o'clock
SteeringWheel.positive: counter-clockwise as seen by the driver = steer left

Beacon.note: red Mars-style rotating light at the front of the rack, lens = child BeaconEmit

HeadlightEmit.note: 4 sealed beams + 4 front bumper parking lamps

TailLightEmit.note: twin bullet tail lights, 2 per fin

BeaconEmit.note: red rotating lens, child of Beacon

InteriorEmit.note: dash gauges, dome light, equipment LEDs

emissive.emissive_factor_note: each *Emit material carries its light colour as emissiveFactor (strength 1); the game drives material.emissiveIntensity (0 = off, >1 blooms); InteriorGaugesEmit uses the gauge texture as emissive map

Seat_Driver.note: avatar hips pose when seated, facing +Z

Exit_Driver.note: avatar root pose after getting out (beside the B-pillar, facing out +X)

TrapStow.note: full trap on the cargo floor behind the rear door, trap front toward the door

Siren.note: siren speaker on the rack, sound source

Exhaust.note: tail pipe under the rear bumper, local +Z = gas direction (rearward)

PackSlot_1.note: pack root pose on the rack; child of PackTray2; world_when_deployed = after tray travel + rack swing (pack +Z = car -Z)

PackSlot_2.note: pack root pose on the rack; child of PackTray2; world_when_deployed = after tray travel + rack swing (pack +Z = car -Z)

PackSlot_3.note: pack root pose on the rack; child of PackTray2; world_when_deployed = after tray travel + rack swing (pack +Z = car -Z)

PackSlot_4.note: pack root pose on the rack; child of PackTray2; world_when_deployed = after tray travel + rack swing (pack +Z = car -Z)

PackPickup_1.note: avatar root pose facing the car that puts PackSlot_1 (deployed) at (0, 1.06, 0.55) rotated 180 deg about Y

PackPickup_2.note: avatar root pose facing the car that puts PackSlot_2 (deployed) at (0, 1.06, 0.55) rotated 180 deg about Y

PackPickup_3.note: avatar root pose facing the car that puts PackSlot_3 (deployed) at (0, 1.06, 0.55) rotated 180 deg about Y

PackPickup_4.note: avatar root pose facing the car that puts PackSlot_4 (deployed) at (0, 1.06, 0.55) rotated 180 deg about Y
